en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet canal or river lined with a stone embankment and a row of mature trees along a cobbled promenade. Iron railings run beside the water, and buildings are visible on the right side across a street. The scene looks tranquil and historical. The word "Uddevalla" is handwritten or printed in script at the lower left, and there is a small oval publisher's mark with additional text at the lower right.
